title: Kevin Zhou - Finance & Legal personal TODOs (Feb-Mar 2026)
content:
Daily scratchpad / quick todo (finance + legal)

Context: personal working notes for small ops items, invoice checks, contract redlines, and upcoming renewals. Not official - will pull items into formal tickets or emails as needed.

TODAY (2026-03-03)
- Priority: vendor invoices + urgent PO approvals
  - [ ] Check invoice INV-2026-0143 (CloudScale) - $23,450.00 - due 2026-03-07.
      - Received 2026-03-01, vendor says invoice already processed on their side. Need AP approval and GL code.
      - Action: confirm PO# PO-5543 matches, code to 'cloud-hosting' (center: infra). Ping Samir for PO match (slack @samir).
  - [ ] Verify INV-2026-0139 (DataProbe) - $3,200.00 - discrepancy: line item for extra agent installs not in contract.
      - Action: hold payment. Email vendor asking for clarification + updated invoice. Put link to previous contract (see linked_artifacts).
  - [x] Run quick sweep of invoices in shared drive folder (finance-invoices-2026) - flagged 2 for review.

CONTRACT REDLINES (inbox)
- Nondisclosure & DPA for vendor 'MetricStream' (Renewal/Amendment)
  - Key asks: limit indemnity cap to 1x fees for direct damages; add DPA appendix referencing our KMS/HSM controls; data return + secure deletion clause with 30 days.
  - Vendor sent back with unilateral audit clause. Need to remove 'continuous audit' language - propose quarterly only.
  - Action: prepare redline (track changes) and send to Rita for legal sign-off. Draft note: 'See edits on indemnity and audit frequency; happy to discuss.'
- Contractor SOW (eng-hire)
  - Add milestone payment schedule (30/40/30) and IP assignment clause.
  - Ask: escalate if hourly cap > $10k/mo.

UPCOMING RENEWALS / REMINDERS
- Datadog (prod) - renewal 2026-03-15.
  - Current commitment: $72k/year. Check whether auto-renew or opt-in.
  - Action: confirm with infra (Ashok) if usage increased - possible downgrade?
- Contract with 'SecureVault' (KMS) - renewal 2026-04-02.
  - Need to confirm CTO/legal on key rotation schedule and SLA credits.
- Office lease (legal ops) - notify facilities if any docs required by landlord by 2026-03-30.

FOLLOW-UPS / EMAILS TO SEND
- To: ap@redwood.ai - subject: 'Hold payment INV-2026-0139 (DataProbe) - clarification needed'
  - Body: short: 'Hi - holding payment pending clarification on extra agent installs billed. Please confirm updated invoice or contract reference. Thanks, Kevin.'
- To: Rita/GTM legal - subject: 'Redline: MetricStream renewal' - attach redline draft.
- To: Samir - slack: 'Quick check: PO-5543 matches INV-2026-0143?'

NOTES / quick reminders
- AP payment windows: ACH runs Tue/Thu. If we need to stop payment before Thu, must escalate EOD Wed.
- For small vendor disputes (<$5k) consider push to next cycle to avoid stop-payment churn.
- Keep holding items in this doc until moved to JIRA (JIRA-9876) for tracking.

MEETING NOTES (finance standup 2026-03-02)
- Ava: onboarding for new vendor invoice template rolling out next week.
- Samir: AP backlog down to 18 items. Working on automations for PO matching.
- Action: Kevin to run monthly invoice reconciliation script on 3/5.

TEMP CHECKLIST (for moving to tickets)
- [ ] Create JIRA ticket for INV-2026-0143 PO mismatch (assign: Samir)
- [ ] Draft redline for MetricStream and upload to Confluence (assign: Kevin -> Rita review)
- [ ] Confirm Datadog renewal decision with infra (Ashok) by 2026-03-09
- [ ] Add SecureVault renewal notes to renewal calendar

Random notes / scratch:
- Possible small vendor credit: CloudScale offered $1,200 credit if invoice paid within 7 days - weigh against cash flow.
- Keep standard clause: 'no continuous access without prior notice' in any vendor monitoring contract.

End of doc - quick, messy. Move items to proper trackers by Friday.
